issues.issue: Did the RPD err by not considering the psychological and medical reports when assessing credibility?
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored the psychological and medical reports, which should have changed its credibility findings.
issues.result_quote: I find that the panel did consider the medical reports and responded appropriately to them.

issues.issue: Did the RPD fail to explain why the discrimination the appellant suffered did not amount to persecution?
issues.applicant_position: RPD gave no explanation of why the discrimination he suffered did not amount to persecution.
issues.result_quote: I disagree with counsel. The panel clearly wrote on this issue

issues.issue: Does the appellant have a political activist profile that puts him at risk in Turkey?
issues.applicant_position: He supported the HDP and BDP parties and was persecuted for it, so he has a political profile.
issues.result_quote: this Appellant, who has no serious political profile (as found by the RPD), has no objective basis for his alleged fears.

issues.issue: Would the appellant face a forward-looking risk of persecution in Turkey as an Alevi Kurd?
issues.applicant_position: As an Alevi Kurd he faces persecution if returned to Turkey, given the country conditions for Kurds.
issues.result_quote: there is more than a mere possibility that this particular Appellant would face persecution as an Alevi Kurd, should he be returned to Turkey

issues.issue: Should the RAD substitute its own decision, or send the matter back to a new RPD panel?
issues.applicant_position: RAD should substitute a finding that he is a Convention refugee; alternatively refer to a differently constituted RPD panel.
issues.result_quote: the RAD sets aside the determination of the RPD and substitutes its determination that the Appellant is a Convention refugee
